Subject: Recap + asks: payment route, tax ID, invoice format (Aurora Health)

Hi Nicole — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and the specific asks so we can keep momentum: 

1) Commercial route: you said procurement prefers a direct PO for the initial phase (vs. card or marketplace). Can you confirm that will be the path for the production contract? If there's any internal requirement to go through AWS Marketplace later, please flag it now.

2) Invoice & billing ops: what invoice receiver email should we use? You mentioned AP@aurorahealth.com but I want the canonical address and mailing/billing address for PDF invoices and for remittance. Also confirm invoice frequency (monthly vs. quarterly).

3) Net terms & tax: you noted finance typically asks for Net45 but can sometimes do Net30. Please confirm the preferred net terms and any approval steps. Also we need Aurora's Tax ID/VAT requirements and the exact billing entity name for the invoice. If you need our EIN and W9, let me know and I can attach.

4) PO format & attachments: if procurement will send a PO, do you have a required PO template or fields we should validate? If you prefer, we can issue an invoice draft for review once we have billing details.

Next steps from our side: I will loop in Marissa (AE) and Ben (billing ops) to validate Redwood's invoice format and confirm our tax/EIN details. If you can share the procurement contact and any sample PO or W9 (if required), that would be ideal.

Thanks — looking forward to the PO so we can lock the start date.

Best,
Aditya Rao

1) Commercial route: Procurement will issue a direct PO for the first year. Marketplace is on the roadmap but not enabled for this purchase right now.

2) Invoice & billing ops: Please send invoices to AP@aurorahealth.com and mail paper invoices to: Aurora Health Tech, Accounts Payable, 4200 Meridian Ave, Suite 210, Seattle, WA 98101. We expect monthly billing for SaaS consumption.

3) Net terms & tax: Finance is targeting Net45 on initial contracts; Net30 may be possible after vendor onboarding. We do not have VAT (US entity) but will need Redwood's EIN and a completed W-9. I've attached our standard PO template and the W-9 request form for vendors. Please confirm Redwood's billing entity name and EIN exactly as you want it printed on the invoice.

4) PO format: attached PO template (PDF) — procurement requires PO number, line item description, start/end dates, and a reference to the SOW/quote. If you can provide a sample invoice that maps to our PO fields, that will accelerate AP review.

I'll follow up with Procurement (procure@aurorahealth.com) if we need anything else.
